# Kokon

> Kokon is a free, open-source desktop app for editing and creating photos with AI on your own computer. You describe the change in plain words ("remove the scooter", "make it a snowy night") and Qwen-Image 2.1 does it locally on your GPU. There is nothing to set up: one installer detects the hardware, downloads and verifies the right model, and picks the resolution and the VRAM/RAM split for every job. Nothing is uploaded.

Key facts (version 0.9.2, October 2026):

- Model: Qwen-Image 2.1 Turbo (official 8-step version, 4-bit GGUF) with Qwen3-VL 8B as the text encoder, run through stable-diffusion.cpp. About 12 GB of models, downloaded once and checked with SHA-256.
- Platforms: Windows 10/11 with an NVIDIA GPU (12 GB VRAM or more, CUDA). AMD and Intel Arc (12 GB+) through Vulkan, beta. Apple Silicon Macs on macOS 26 (Metal), beta: 16 GB works slowly, 32 GB recommended. No Linux build yet.
- Speed: RTX 5070 Ti about 24 s per edit at 1.5K and 36 s for a new image at native 2K; RTX 5070 12 GB about 12 s per 1-megapixel image; M2 Pro about 4 minutes per image.
- Features: create from text, edit with a sentence, paint an area and Change/Remove/Replace/Add only there, combine several images ("image 1", "image 2"), expand beyond the borders (outpainting), AI upscaling, versions with undo and before/after compare, private mode, works offline after setup.
- For AI agents: built-in MCP server (generate_image, edit_image, inpaint_image, outpaint_image, upscale_image, ...) and a local HTTP API. `npx -y kokon-mcp`; listed in the official MCP Registry as io.github.GabrieleLozupone/kokon.
- License: the app is AGPL-3.0. The Qwen-Image 2.1 weights are under the Qwen Research License, which does not allow commercial use.
- Not yet: Linux; code signing (Windows SmartScreen and macOS Gatekeeper warn on first run).
- Made by Gabriele Lozupone, an AI researcher. Independent project, not affiliated with Alibaba or the Qwen team.

## Pages

- [Home](https://kokon.app/): what Kokon does, examples, requirements, FAQ
- [Run Qwen-Image 2.1 locally](https://kokon.app/qwen-image-2-1-local/): step-by-step setup on Windows and Mac without Python or ComfyUI, speed, troubleshooting
- [Prompt guide](https://kokon.app/prompt-guide/): how to write prompts for Qwen-Image 2.1, with vague vs clear examples (negative prompts, text in images, edit prompts)
- [Free local image generation for AI agents (MCP)](https://kokon.app/mcp-image-generation/): use Kokon from Claude Code, Cursor or any MCP client

## Code and downloads

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/GabrieleLozupone/kokon): source, README, issues
- [Latest release](https://github.com/GabrieleLozupone/kokon/releases/latest): Windows installer and Mac app
- [npm package kokon-mcp](https://www.npmjs.com/package/kokon-mcp): MCP server launcher
- [Demo video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ulMVqrhrn-w): 85 seconds
